intent: Implement `solve`: `n` is an 8-bit integer (in [-128, 127]) with n >= 10 or n <= -10. For n >= 0 return n. For negative n return the larger of floor(n / 10) and floor(n / 100) * 10 + (n mod 10), where floor division rounds toward negative infinity and n mod 10 is the remainder in [0, 10) (deleting the last digit, or the digit before it). The contract must state the result exactly.
